title: How to organise the primary prep counter | Kitchen
description:
The stretch of counter where food is actually cut, mixed, and plated.

This is the Primary Prep Counter in the Kitchen. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One clear run of counter at least as wide as your largest cutting board, holding only the board, the knife block or strip, and the salt. The kettle and the toaster stand back against the wall with their cords coiled, and there is no mail, no fruit bowl, and no charging phone anywhere on the surface.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take everything off the counter and set it on the dining table, then let only three things back: what you cut
Straighten: Put the board where you already stand without thinking, then build outward from it.
Shine: Lift the toaster and the kettle instead of wiping around them, because crumbs collect under the appliance feet
Safety: Knives belong in a block, on a magnetic strip, or in a bladed sleeve in a drawer, never loose among the utensi
Standardize: Mark the clear run so it is not a matter of opinion.
Sustain: When you start the dishwasher, the board goes back down onto bare counter.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The clear run stays clear: one board, one knife block or strip, one seasoning within reach, and nothing parked on the work surface overnight.
